summary_list.suggested_action: Raise the placement mismatch to the career services team to review task relevance and reassign the student to a role matching the course curriculum.
Ask the tutor to streamline the tutorial by avoiding unnecessary repetition of already‑covered examples, focusing on new content.
Alert the module coordinator to publish the updated rubric promptly and inform all students of the change, ensuring alignment with assessment criteria.
Discuss with the printing services team to increase trimester credit allocation or provide a low‑cost top‑up option for students needing hard‑copy reports.

overall_summary: This summary covers 4 of 6 feedback entries received. Assessment has a high‑severity issue: rubric changed last minute without notice (high). Internship Placement also has a high‑severity problem: placement tasks unrelated to the course, limited to photocopying and data entry (high). Facilities shows a medium‑severity concern: printing credits run out quickly each trimester, forcing out‑of‑pocket costs. Teaching Quality includes a low‑severity comment: tutorial repeats an example unnecessarily, wasting session time.
